title: Adapt: Don't fail when we run on a host with 1 core (#14582)

timeline.message:
Adapt: Don't fail when we run on a host with 1 core (#14582)

Motivation:

We require that the minimum queue size is 2 and use the number of cores
as default value which can be less.

Modifications:

If we see less then 2 cores just use 2 as default size

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14579
timeline.author: Norman Maurer
